title: Traefik Fix Protects Shared Connection Boundaries
caption:
Traefik released updates to address a high-severity cross-user response poisoning vulnerability affecting specific proxy and backend protocol combinations. Defenders should verify running proxy versions, apply patches, and review shared connection pools across ingress paths.
